preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string S must be equal to N.
The input S must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-empty substring of S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout in S and S.count(stdout) >= 2)
postconditions.description: If a repeating non-overlapping substring exists, it must be returned; otherwise, return -1.
The output must be the longest repeating non-overlapping substring found.
